This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution: you’ll bring a strong accounting foundation, step confidently into hands-on operational work when needed, and guide the business with clear, data-driven insight.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">This is a hands on builder role. You bring a software development background and deep technical instincts to diagnose root causes, reproduce edge cases, write or read code to understand issues at depth, and work directly with the Engineering team to drive resolution. This is not a traditional support role - you will spend a significant portion of your time doing technical investigation work that sits at the boundary of support and engineering.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">This role requires participation on a on-call rotation including weekends and holidays.</p><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\"></p><h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2><ul style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Investigate and reproduce customer-reported bugs, data inconsistencies, and integration failures across Rewind's supported platforms (Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Shopify, QuickBooks Online, and more)</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Read and write code (primarily in the context of debugging and scripting) to diagnose issues, test hypotheses, and validate fixes</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Work directly with Engineering to clearly articulate bugs, provide reproducible test cases, and track fixes through to resolution</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Manage and resolve issues in customer environments involving API integrations, OAuth configurations, webhook failures, and platform-level permissions</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Handle data restoration requests and complex recovery scenarios requiring deep knowledge of Rewind's backup architecture</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Own enterprise customer onboarding when required, including installation, deployment, and education, ensuring the customer is fully set up for success</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Help build and maintain the internal knowledge base for complex issue patterns, enabling T1/T2 to self-serve future resolutions</p></li><li><p style=\"min-height:1.5em\">Participate in on-call rotations for P1 You can find them all here https://rewind.com/blog/.\n\nThriving at Rewind:\n\nWe embrace the fast-paced, ever-changing nature of startup life. If you love working with speed, agility, and creativity, you’ll feel right at home here. Here's what it takes to succeed with us:\n\n - Team-First Mentality: We put teamwork at the core of everything we do, believing that we are better when we are together. Success is shared, and when the team wins, we all win.\n\n - Performance-Driven Mindset: We are proactive, goal-oriented, and focused on delivering tangible, high-quality results. We go beyond meeting expectations - we aim to exceed them.\n\n - Flexible Work-Life Approach: We encourage balance and understand the need to recharge. While we stay agile for urgent needs, we make sure there's time to recover and enjoy life.\n\n - Customer Centricity: Our commitment to customers shapes everything we do. We listen, build relationships, and innovate - from our dedicated customer support team to our engineers, everyone at our company is focused on solving problems that matter most to our users.\n\n - Taking Initiative: We value ownership and proactive problem-solving. We encourage team members to think creatively, take ownership, and lead improvements. Your ideas and actions drive our success.\n\n - We Make Time for Fun: We work hard and make time to enjoy the journey. It’s not just about hitting milestones—it’s about making the experience rewarding along the way.\n\nThe Senior Technical Support Engineer (T3) is the highest tier of our support organization, serving as a bridge between customer support and engineering. You will own the most complex, ambiguous technical escalations that our T1 and T2 teams cannot resolve - including issues that previously required involvement from the Engineering Run Team.\n\n\n\n\n\nTHE ROLE\n\nAs a Senior Technical Support Engineer, you will serve as the final escalation point within the support organization. You bring a software development background and deep technical instincts to diagnose root causes, reproduce edge cases, write or read code to understand issues at depth, and work directly with the Engineering team to drive resolution. This is not a traditional support role - you will spend a significant portion of your time doing technical investigation work that sits at the boundary of support and engineering.\n\nThis role requires participation on a on-call rotation including weekends and holidays.\n\n\n\n\nWHAT YOU'LL DO\n\n - Own the most complex technical escalations from T1 and T2, serving as the final line of defense.\n\n - Investigate and reproduce customer-reported bugs, data inconsistencies, and integration failures across Rewind's supported platforms (Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Shopify, QuickBooks Online, and more)\n\n - Read and write code (primarily in the context of debugging and scripting) to diagnose issues, test hypotheses, and validate fixes\n\n - Work directly with Engineering to clearly articulate bugs, provide reproducible test cases, and track fixes through to resolution\n\n - Manage and resolve issues in customer environments involving API integrations, OAuth configurations, webhook failures, and platform-level permissions\n\n - Handle data restoration requests and complex recovery scenarios requiring deep knowledge of Rewind's backup architecture\n\n - Own enterprise customer onboarding when required, including installation, deployment, and education, ensuring the customer is fully set up for success\n\n - Help build and maintain the internal knowledge base for complex issue patterns, enabling T1/T2 to self-serve future resolutions\n\n - Participate in on-call rotations for P1 incidents affecting enterprise customers\n\n - Identify recurring escalation patterns and proactively surface product improvement opportunities to Engineering and Product\n\n\n\n\nWHAT YOU BRING\n\nRequired\n\n - 5+ years of experience in a technical support, solutions engineering, or software development role\n\n - Computer Science degree or equivalent practical experience (you can read and write code)\n\n - Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, Ruby, JavaScript, or similar)\n\n - Strong understanding of REST APIs, OAuth, webhooks, and modern SaaS integration patterns\n\n - Experience with cloud platforms and SaaS ecosystems (Atlassian, GitHub, Shopify, or similar)\n\n - AWS - CloudWatch for logs, OpenSearch/Kibana for search infrastructure, SQS/SNS for async processing\n\n - Ability to read logs, inspect API responses, and debug issues at the network and application layers\n\n - Exceptional written and verbal communication - you can explain a complex technical root cause to a non-technical customer and to an engineer on the same day\n\n - Comfort working independently in ambiguous, high-stakes situations with limited documentation\n\nNice to Have\n\n - Experience with backup, recovery, or data resilience products\n\n - Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, or Atlassian platform administration\n\n - Experience with PostgreSQL and DynamoDB\n\n - Prior experience in a SaaS company at a similar scale (Series B / growth stage)\n\n - Experience working with enterprise customers and navigating complex account relationships\n\n\n\n\nLOCATION\n\nThere is a strong preference for candidates based in Ontario for easier collaboration.\n\n\n\nCompensation Philosophy\nThe actual base salary will vary based on various factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process. The listed range above is a guideline, and the base salary range for this role may be modified.\n\nIf your expectations are above this range, it may be because your experience aligns with a more senior level. In some cases, we’re open to hiring at a higher level for the right person and are committed to paying competitively and fairly.\n\nIf your experience is closer to an earlier career stage, we may still consider your application. In that case, we would evaluate the role at a different level within our levelling framework, which would correspond to a salary below the range shown.\n\nPay is just one part of the overall compensation at Rewind.\n\n\n\nWhy join Rewind\n\nAt Rewind, you’ll help shape the future of data protection for thousands of businesses.
